     text = format_summary(0, 0, None)
     assert text == (
         "Total rows: 0\nTotal columns: 0\nFirst data row: None"

+
+
+def test_quoted_comma_field_is_single_column(tmp_path):
+    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,age,city\n"Doe, Jane",30,"Springfield, IL"\n')
+    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
+    assert rows == 1
+    assert columns == 3
+    assert first == ["Doe, Jane", "30", "Springfield, IL"]
